Instructions: SETUP: big beads through focus (docs/BEAD_CALIBRATION.md, 'Big beads through focus'; sizer 3.0.0 Phase 3). Three single-size sandwiches, the same 31 depths as Thursday's mixed one, biggest first; about 1.5 h (Thursday's series ran ~55 s a row). EMPTY or DISCONNECT the silicone line and HOME the traverse first (93 rows x 0.5 mm = 46.5 mm of nudges; the travel is 72.5 mm). Do NOT touch the lens (focus ring, aperture) or the backlight, and do not move the camera during the series. Exposure 4 us, 2048 x 1152, 390 fps. Camera tab: Run AI analysis OFF, Window check OFF, Auto-trigger ON. Mount the 155.8 um sandwich (coverslip towards the camera) square to the camera at the spray plane. Find best focus on its beads with the micrometer, by eye: that reading is z0 (write it down). Exact focus does not matter: the analysis finds best focus from the blur. Then turn back a little past z0 - 8.00 mm (e.g. -8.5, or as far as the stage goes) and forward to z0 - 8.00 mm, so the backlash is taken up. From here on always turn the SAME way (forward, towards +8). Do not slide the sandwich sideways during this slide's rows.
